# Changelog

## v1.0.5

- Edit captions in the app: text, timing, add, delete
- Caption text follows the system caption preferences
- Live Caption: settings and switch in one row; export/import .srt/.vtt
- AI captions download from the original public sources, SHA-256 checked
- Ungreyed HDR/SDR Chips
- Any playback speed allowed
- Updates download inside the app and open the installer, no browser; Redownload is now ReInstall
- Developer options: Show Unsupported File (non-video files greyed out in Folders) and an in-app data file manager (app cache, files, data)
- Copy / move: progress with file name and size, Cancel button (removes partly copied files), folders can be copied, and you can paste into storage and Libraries folders from the Folders list
- Fix corrupted strip at the top or bottom of some videos
- Improve refresh button
- Bug fixes: system status bar color doesn't auto update, etc i have no clue idk bro ✌🏻😔
